runs.text: This Privacy Policy explains how 주식회사 토일렛 아카이브, also identified in English as tva ltd (“we,” “us,” or “our”), collects, uses, stores, and shares personal information through Soul Trace and related Eternal Beam services.
This Policy applies to features currently offered through Soul Trace, including personalized letter generation, stamps, account access, saved archive content, and Kickstarter launch notifications.
The data controller for Soul Trace is:
Soul Trace and Eternal Beam are service names operated by the same controller.
When you request a personalized Soul Trace letter, we may collect:
Your pet’s species, type, breed, and gender
The length of time you have been together or a relevant date range
The intended recipient of the letter
Your answers to questions about memories and experiences with your pet
Your preferred letter mood, tone, style, and length
Relevant service, campaign, referral, partner, or channel information

Please avoid including unnecessary information about other people, government-issued identifiers, financial information, precise addresses, or sensitive human health information in questionnaire answers.
You may upload pet photos for supported features, including stamps and Life Archive content.

Uploaded photos may contain metadata added by your camera or device, such as the date and time of capture, device information, or location data. Soul Trace does not currently remove all embedded metadata from every uploaded image. If this is a concern, please remove sensitive metadata before uploading a photo.
Uploaded photos may be stored through our service provider, Supabase, or temporarily in your browser when needed to provide the selected feature.
Uploaded pet photos are not sent to OpenAI as part of the current letter-generation process.
Life Archive photos, videos, and written memories
Information connecting saved content with your account, submission, or archive

AI-generated letters are creative content based on the information you provide. They should not be understood as the actual thoughts or communications of a pet, or as professional, medical, or psychological advice.
If you register or use an authenticated feature, we may process:
Email-confirmation, sign-in, one-time-password, or recovery information
Authentication is provided through Supabase Auth.
If you join the Kickstarter notification list, we collect your:
Joining the waitlist records your interest in receiving launch information. Soul Trace does not currently operate a general marketing-email campaign.
A required privacy choice for generating a personalized letter
You must accept the required privacy choice before letter generation can begin. Optional choices do not prevent you from generating a letter.
Consent and preference selections may be retained temporarily in your browser as part of your questionnaire session.
When you use Soul Trace, we and our service providers may process limited technical information needed to operate and protect the service, such as:
Service, campaign, referral, or partner identifiers
More information about cookies and browser storage appears in Schedule B.
Adapt the letter’s language, personality, tone, and style
Restore an in-progress questionnaire or result
Connect a submission with the appropriate service, partner, or channel
We use OpenAI to provide letter generation and related AI-assisted functions.
Information sent to OpenAI for these purposes may include:
Your email address and uploaded pet photo are not sent to OpenAI in the current letter-generation process.
Questionnaire text and pet information may also be used to create a prompt for an associated generated image.
The current service does not use questionnaire answers, uploaded photos, or generated letters for general AI model training or fine-tuning.
Protect restricted content and archive access
Supabase Auth may send authentication-related emails, including confirmation, sign-in, and account-recovery messages.
We use Supabase database and storage services to support:
Some information may also be retained temporarily in your browser while a questionnaire or archive feature is in progress.
We use Kickstarter waitlist information to record your interest in Eternal Beam launch announcements.
If we introduce marketing-email delivery, we will use marketing information in accordance with your applicable choices and provide any controls required by law.
3.6 Service operation, security, and legal compliance
We may use information as reasonably necessary to:
Operate, maintain, and improve service reliability
Diagnose errors and resolve technical problems
Prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access
Establish, exercise, or defend legal claims
If you access Soul Trace through a partner, referral, QR code, or campaign link, we may record the associated source, partner, or channel identifier.
A referral does not give the referring partner access to your private questionnaire answers, uploaded photos, or generated letters.
We disclose personal information only where reasonably necessary to provide the service, operate our business, protect users, or comply with applicable law.
We provide relevant questionnaire answers, pet information, generation preferences, and prompts to OpenAI for AI-assisted letter and image generation.
We do not send your email address or uploaded pet photo to OpenAI in the current letter-generation process.
We use Supabase for authentication, database functions, and file storage.
Depending on the feature you use, Supabase may process:
Uploaded photos, videos, and archive files
Stamps, generated images, and related references
We may disclose information where reasonably necessary and legally permitted to:
Comply with applicable law or legal process
Respond to an enforceable government request
Protect users, the service, or the rights and safety of others
Investigate fraud, misuse, or security incidents
Establish, exercise, or defend legal claims
Support a merger, acquisition, reorganization, or transfer of the relevant business
Any such disclosure will be limited to what is reasonably necessary and permitted by law.
Soul Trace may provide links to external platforms, including social-media or Kickstarter pages. When you visit an external service, that service processes information under its own privacy policy.
Soul Trace does not currently use advertising pixels, behavioral-advertising systems, session-replay tools, or web-analytics services.
We do not sell personal information or disclose it for cross-context behavioral advertising through the current Soul Trace service.
We operate from the Republic of Korea.

OpenAI, Supabase, and their service providers may process or make personal information accessible in countries outside your country of residence. The relevant locations may depend on provider infrastructure, service regions, account settings, subprocessors, support arrangements, and backup systems.

Where required by applicable law, we will provide information about relevant overseas recipients, transfer purposes, categories of information, destination countries, retention arrangements, and available safeguards.
Users may contact us using the information in Section 12 to request further information about international processing relevant to their personal information.

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy, to maintain the applicable service or archive, and to meet legitimate legal, security, and operational requirements.
Questionnaire answers and related information are retained for as long as reasonably necessary to provide and maintain the requested Soul Trace service.
Questionnaire information may be stored in our service database and temporarily in your browser while a questionnaire or result session is active.
Uploaded pet photos may be stored where needed for the requested feature or archive and retained for as long as reasonably necessary for that purpose.
6.3 Generated letters, stamps, and saved content
Generated letters, stamps, and associated saved content may be retained while needed for the relevant Soul Trace service or archive, unless deleted earlier or no longer needed.
Certain Life Archive photos, written memories, and videos can be deleted through the controls provided for those items.
Deletion of an individual archive item may not automatically delete other records associated with an account, questionnaire, letter, or service request.
Session information may remain until the browser session ends, the application replaces or removes it, or you clear your browser data.
Language preferences, themes, and temporary archive information may remain in browser storage until changed, removed, or cleared through your browser settings.
Technical, security, and troubleshooting records may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary for service operation, security, troubleshooting, and applicable legal obligations.
OpenAI and Supabase may retain information according to their service configuration, applicable terms, security requirements, and legal obligations.

Deleting information from an active service may not immediately remove copies maintained in restricted security records or provider backups where temporary continued retention is necessary and legally permitted.
Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have the right to:
Request information about how your personal information is processed
Request access to your personal information
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
Request portable copies of eligible information
Submit a complaint to an appropriate privacy or data-protection authority
These rights may be subject to identity verification, legal limitations, and permitted retention requirements.

Users may contact us to request access, correction, deletion, or other privacy-related actions. A request to delete an individual Life Archive item is different from a broader request concerning account, questionnaire, letter, or related service information.
We may retain limited information where required to comply with law, protect legal rights, prevent fraud, resolve disputes, or document the handling of a privacy request.
You must accept the required privacy choice before Soul Trace can use your questionnaire answers to generate a personalized letter.
If you do not accept this choice, letter generation will not proceed.
The marketing choice is optional. Declining it does not prevent you from generating a Soul Trace letter.
Soul Trace does not currently operate a general marketing-email campaign. Authentication emails, such as confirmation, sign-in, or recovery messages, are service communications rather than marketing.
If marketing communications are introduced, they will be handled in accordance with your applicable choices and legal requirements.
The AI-improvement choice is optional and does not affect your ability to generate a letter.
The current service does not use questionnaire answers, uploaded photos, or generated letters for general AI model training or fine-tuning.
Soul Trace is intended for adults and does not invite children to submit personal information independently.
Please do not submit personal information about a child unless you have the authority required under applicable law.
If we learn that a child’s personal information has been collected in circumstances that do not comply with applicable requirements, we will take appropriate steps in accordance with the law.
A parent or legal guardian may contact us regarding personal information relating to a child.
We use reasonable technical and organizational measures intended to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.
Restricted access to database and storage functions
HTTP-only cookies for certain access functions
Secure transmission through supported network protocols
Measures intended to detect and address misuse or security incidents
Our service providers also maintain security measures for the services they provide.

No online service or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. You should protect your authentication information and avoid submitting unnecessary sensitive information through questionnaires or uploads.
We may update this Privacy Policy when our services, providers, legal obligations, or information-handling practices change.
When changes are material, we will provide an appropriate notice through the service or another suitable communication method where required by law.
Where a new activity requires consent, continued use of Soul Trace will not by itself constitute consent to an unrelated marketing, AI-training, advertising, or public-content purpose.
Questions, concerns, and privacy-related requests may be directed to:

Please describe your request clearly and provide sufficient information for us to identify the relevant account or service record. We may request additional information where reasonably necessary to verify your identity and protect personal information from unauthorized access.
Schedule A — Providers and Overseas Processing
Questionnaire answers, pet details, recipient information, tone, mood, length, language, and generation prompts
Generating personalized letters, related language or personality results, and associated images
Email address, account identifier, authentication information, session data, language preference, and security information
Registration, confirmation, sign-in, one-time-password functions, recovery, and authenticated access
Profile information, questionnaire answers, pet information, generated letters, waitlist records, partner or channel information, and service-access records
Providing, maintaining, and securing Soul Trace features
Uploaded pet photos, Life Archive content, videos, stamps, generated images, and related files
Providing persistent storage for supported features and archives
Supabase Auth and its supporting delivery infrastructure
Email address, authentication message, sign-in or recovery link or code, and delivery information
Sending confirmation, sign-in, and recovery communications

OpenAI and Supabase may process information in countries where they or their subprocessors maintain infrastructure or provide support. Processing locations and retention may vary according to the service, selected region, account configuration, and applicable provider terms.

We do not provide uploaded pet photos to OpenAI in the current letter-generation process. We also do not provide user information to OpenAI for general AI model training or fine-tuning through the current Soul Trace service.
Schedule B — Technical Data, Cookies and U.S. Disclosures
Soul Trace uses cookies and browser storage to provide necessary features and remember user preferences.

Some cookies used for submission, access, or authentication are HTTP-only and cannot be read directly by ordinary browser scripts.
Blocking or clearing necessary cookies and browser storage may interrupt authentication, draft restoration, submission access, language preferences, or archive functions.
Soul Trace does not currently remove all embedded metadata from every uploaded image. Users who do not want this information included should remove sensitive metadata before uploading a photo.
Uploaded pet photos are not sent to OpenAI in the current letter-generation process.
Soul Trace and its service providers may process limited technical information necessary to:
Technical, security, and troubleshooting records may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary for service operation, security, troubleshooting, and applicable legal obligations.
Soul Trace does not currently use:
Email-open or link tracking controlled by Soul Trace
External platforms may collect technical information when you choose to follow an external link, subject to their own privacy policies.
Depending on applicable U.S. state law, Soul Trace may process the following categories of personal information:
Email address, account identifier, submission identifier
Authentication, waitlist registration, service access, and account functions
Questionnaire answers, memories, pet details, and uploaded photos
Letter generation, stamps, archives, and requested content
Letters, personality results, generated images, and stamp information
Providing and maintaining Soul Trace services
Sessions, cookies, browser storage, requests, errors, and security events
Service operation, authentication, security, and troubleshooting
Language, theme, mood, tone, style, and length
Personalizing the service and generated content
Kickstarter registration, partner, referral, or channel identifiers
Recording launch interest and understanding how users reached the service
Soul Trace does not currently sell personal information or disclose it for cross-context behavioral advertising.

Users may submit requests concerning rights available under applicable U.S. state law through the contact information in Section 12. Such requests may be subject to identity verification and applicable legal exceptions.
